# Decorative Line

`decorative/line` &middot; content-level &middot; category: decorative

## Purpose

A decorative rule for emphasis: accent bar, double line, dotted line or dot ornament.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Short accent bar (the accent line).
- **wide**: A full-width accent line. Sets `length: 100%`, `thickness: 1px`.
- **double**: Double rule. Sets `style: double`, `thickness: 4px`, `length: 64px`.
- **dotted**: Dotted rule. Sets `style: dotted`, `length: 96px`.
- **ornament**: Three dots as a section ornament. Sets `style: ornament`, `color: @colors.mutedText`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `style` | one of `solid`, `double`, `dotted`, `dashed`, `ornament` | `"solid"` |
| `color` | color | `"@theme.accent.color"` |
| `thickness` | length | `"@theme.accent.lineWidth"` |
| `length` | length | `"@theme.accent.lineLength"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solid bars honored. Dotted and double can render as solid. | Fine. | Accent color stays. Ornament uses the muted color. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('decorative/line', {}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "decorative/line",
  "data": {}
}
```
